items.exampleEn: Sleep plays an important role in the retention of new information.
items.exampleZh: 睡眠對記住新資訊扮演重要的角色。

items.exampleEn: She embarked on a new career at the age of forty.
items.exampleZh: 她在四十歲時展開了新的職業生涯。

items.exampleEn: Use the map to find the elevation of each village.
items.exampleZh: 用地圖查出每個村莊的海拔高度。

items.exampleEn: She flicked through a magazine while she waited for the bus.
items.exampleZh: 她一邊等公車，一邊快速翻著雜誌。

items.exampleEn: The cake crumbled when I tried to cut it.
items.exampleZh: 我想切蛋糕的時候，它碎掉了。

items.exampleEn: The pilot performed a difficult maneuver to avoid the birds.
items.exampleZh: 機師做了一個困難的動作，避開了鳥群。

items.exampleEn: The birds came down to eat the bread crumbs in the park.
items.exampleZh: 鳥兒飛下來吃公園裡的麵包屑。

items.exampleEn: Her music is a fusion of jazz and folk songs.
items.exampleZh: 她的音樂融合了爵士樂和民謠。

items.sentenceEn: He flicked the switch, but the light did not come on.
items.sentenceZh: 他按了一下開關，但燈沒有亮。

items.audioEn: The town sits at an elevation of two thousand meters, so nights are cold even in summer.
items.audioZh: 這個小鎮位於海拔兩千公尺，所以即使是夏天，晚上也很冷。
items.questionZh: 為什麼這個小鎮夏天的晚上也很冷？

items.sentenceEn: The old stone wall is starting to crumble.
items.sentenceZh: 那道老石牆開始崩落了。

items.sentenceEn: This restaurant serves a fusion of Thai and Italian food.
items.sentenceZh: 這家餐廳供應泰式與義式的融合料理。

items.stemEn: Good pay and regular training help improve staff ____.
items.stemZh: 良好的薪資和定期訓練有助於留住員工。

items.stemEn: She swept the ____ off the table after breakfast.
items.stemZh: 早餐後，她把桌上的碎屑掃掉。

items.passageEn: Last summer, my cousin Jay embarked on a two-week cycling trip through the mountains. He had studied the route beforehand, but the reality was harder than he expected. At higher elevations, the air was thin and every hill felt endless. In some places, the old roads had begun to crumble, so he had to maneuver his bike carefully around large holes. One evening, he reached a small village where a family invited him in for dinner. They served a fusion of local and Western cooking, and he ate every last crumb. He says that dinner was the best part of the whole trip.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我的表親 Jay 展開了一趟為期兩週的山區單車之旅。他事先研究過路線，但實際狀況比他預期的還要辛苦。在海拔較高的地方，空氣稀薄，每一座山坡都像是騎不完。有些路段的老舊路面已經開始崩裂，他得小心操控腳踏車繞過大坑洞。某天傍晚，他抵達一座小村子，一戶人家邀他進屋吃晚餐。他們端出融合在地與西式風味的料理，他吃得一點不剩。他說那頓晚餐是整趟旅程中最棒的部分。

questions.questionZh: 在某些路段，Jay 為什麼得小心操控腳踏車？
options: 路上常有野生動物出沒

questions.questionZh: Jay 認為整趟旅程最棒的是什麼？

items.promptZh: 公司計畫明年展開一項新的研究計畫。
referenceEn: The company plans to embark on a new research project next year.
Next year, the company is planning to embark on a new research project.
rubricZh: embark on＋名詞表示「著手、展開」（例如 embark on a new project 等）
「計畫（做）」可寫，例如 plans to、is planning to、intends to 等
「研究計畫」可寫，例如 research project、research program 等

items.promptZh: 工人們小心地把鋼琴移過狹窄的門口。
referenceEn: The workers carefully maneuvered the piano through the narrow doorway.
The workers maneuvered the piano carefully through the narrow door.
rubricZh: 「小心地移過」用 maneuver＋受詞＋介系詞片語（例如 maneuvered the piano through… 等）
「小心地」可寫，例如 carefully，放動詞前或句中皆可
「門口」可寫，例如 doorway、door 等；時態配合內容；過去式、現在完成式都正確
